question.text: The wavelength of an X-ray beam is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mo>Å</mo></math>. The mass of a fictitious particle having the same energy as that of the X-ray photons is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo> </mo><mi>h</mi><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is ___ . (<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo></math>Planck's constant)
